snippet.title: death by flower arrangement v1.1 | what's new?
snippet.description:
PLAY THE GAME NOW!
Available in your browser, or as a desktop app!
- https://sylverstone14.itch.io/death-by-flower-arrangement
- https://gamejolt.com/games/death-by-flower-arrangement/250284
__________________

Version 1.1 of death by flower arrangement is finally here!

After tinkering with the game on and off for the last four months, I've finally decided to release an update to my colorful 2D shooter.

There's a ton of things I changed up visually and technically (thanks to generous feedback), and compared to its initial game jam release, this feels a bit more cleaned up.

Hopefully y'all can give it a go and maybe tell me how great it is, or how much it sucks. Whichever works. :P

--- Music ---
* "Flower Umbrella" - ナニダトnanidato
- https://soundcloud.com/futuresocietycollective/nanidato-flower-umbrella
